verdict.rationale: Brevo's own pricing docs claim unlimited automated multi-step workflows that engage users along their journey. They also document sign-up-triggered follow-up emails, which fits a welcome series, and score-based automation triggers. However, nothing in the pack documents conditional branches, wait or delay steps, or exit rules, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented branching/conditional splits, delay/wait steps, exit/goal rules, explicit onboarding/winback templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: Create an unlimited number of automated, multi-step workflows to engage users at key moments along their journey.
Automatically trigger follow-up emails as soon as someone signs up.
Get contact scores based on engagement, purchases, and behaviors to trigger automations or create targeted segments.
